profile.name: Rahul Kumar
profile.title: Associate Engineer · Cloud & Data Engineering
profile.tagline: Engineer at the intersection of cloud data engineering, AI/ML, and full-stack development.
profile.description: Currently building scalable Azure data pipelines at Nagarro using ADF, Databricks & Delta Lake. Previously interned at MakeMyTrip (Product Analytics) and Bharti Airtel Foundation (AI Automation).

experience.description: Transitioned to full-time Associate Engineer on 12th September 2026. Designing, scaling, and optimizing end-to-end cloud data pipelines on Azure (ADF, ADLS Gen2, Databricks) implementing medallion architecture (Bronze–Silver–Gold) with Delta Lake for enterprise data processing.
highlights: Full-time Associate Engineer as of 12th Sept 2026 (previously Associate Engineer Trainee from 01/2026).
Built & deployed an end-to-end cloud data pipeline on Azure (ADF + ADLS Gen2 + Databricks) with medallion architecture (Bronze–Silver–Gold) using Delta Lake.
Developed parameterized ETL workflows using PySpark & Azure Data Factory — handling schema drift, missing data, and automated ingestion with scheduled triggers.
Optimized big data workloads via Spark techniques (partitioning, caching, broadcast joins, Z-Ordering) and implemented monitoring, logging & data quality checks.

experience.description: Built and deployed end-to-end cloud data pipelines on Azure integrating ADF, ADLS Gen2, and Databricks, implementing medallion architecture (Bronze–Silver–Gold) with Delta Lake, parameterized PySpark ETL workflows, and Spark workload optimizations.

Analyzed user funnels across PWA and SEO/SEM journeys to identify drop-offs and abnormal behavior using session-level insights. Built custom dashboards to track conversion trends, search anomalies, and booking pain points. Led large-scale hotel deduplication using rule-based logic and DinoV2 vision embeddings, and generated AI-powered SEM ad copies for major tourist cities.

Developed the complete backend infrastructure for an AI-based Question Bank Generator app using Node.js and Express, integrating with PostgreSQL using sequelize ORM to manage a large-scale question database for 100,000 potential users.

projects.title: OS_Agent
projects.description: 100% offline autonomous OS intelligence agent (AEGIS) powered by local LLMs (LM Studio, Ollama) that translates natural language into structured, policy-validated execution plans across 100+ desktop, file, terminal, git, web, and Whisper voice tools with FTS5 search and task scheduling.

projects.title: Unpackr
projects.tagline: Low-Disk-Space Archive Extraction Engine in Rust
projects.description: High-performance archive extraction engine and native desktop app built in Rust that eliminates the 2x disk footprint requirement (~48% peak storage savings) by progressively punching 4KB block-aligned filesystem holes in-place while preserving ZIP structure, cryptographic CRC-32 integrity, and crash resumability.

projects.title: myVCS
projects.tagline: Custom Version Control System in C++17
projects.description: Custom VCS in C++17 with content-addressed storage, SHA-256 hashing, zlib compression, commit DAG, branching, three-way merge, diff engine, stash, and 25+ integration tests.
